description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\ClientSideMonitoring namespace. It provides methods for loading and managing configuration settings related to AWS Client Side Monitoring (CSM), including environment variable parsing, INI file reading, and default fallback options. The class supports composition of multiple providers and caching of configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various static methods to create and compose configuration providers for AWS Client Side Monitoring, including environment-based, INI file-based, fallback, and cached providers. Supports default configurations and resolving configuration promises.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that loads from environment variables, shared config files, or uses fallback options. Supports caching if a CacheInterface is provided.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Returns a provider function that loads CSM configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Returns a provider function that provides default fallback configuration options.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Returns a provider function that loads configuration from a specified INI file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Resolves various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
